result: Fixed the open redirect in `app/Http/Controllers/Auth/LoginController.ts`: added a `safeRedirectPath()` helper that resolves the incoming `redirect` value against a fixed dummy origin (`new URL(value, 'http://same-origin.invalid')`) and only accepts it if the value starts with `/` and the resolved origin is unchanged — this rejects absolute URLs, protocol-relative (`//evil.example`), and backslash variants (`/\evil.example`) alike, since WHATWG URL parsing (matching browser behavior) treats a leading backslash the same as a forward slash. `store()` now uses `safeRedirectPath(redirect) ?? safeRedirectPath(query redirect) ?? '/dashboard'` instead of the raw value, so a rejected redirect falls back to the same default destination as a login with no `redirect` at all; login/auth behavior (success and failure) is untouched. Added `tests/LoginController.test.ts` covering the default destination, an in-app path (`/posts/3/edit`), the three attack variants from the report, and that a wrong password still fails without a session. `bun run typecheck`, `bun test` (8 pass), and `bunx guren check` all pass.
